def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    taxable_income = 82_000
    tax_brackets = [
        (10_000, 0.10),
        (30_000, 0.20),
        (60_000, 0.30),
        (float("inf"), 0.40),
    ]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_tax = 0
    previous_limit = 0
    for upper_limit, rate in tax_brackets:
        income_in_bracket = max(0, min(taxable_income, upper_limit) - previous_limit)
        total_tax += income_in_bracket * rate
        previous_limit = upper_limit
        if taxable_income <= upper_limit:
            break

    # Return answer rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(total_tax)
